bench.name: link_e2_eq
bench.note: link-level lockstep miter ot_hgi_coll_link_e1 (body link_e2) == original ot_hgi_coll_link_e, every output every cycle, 60k cycles: legal calendar epochs + per-epoch fault injection; needs >1000 TX and RX frames and >10 aborted epochs (measured 16,873 TX / 16,637 RX / 54 aborted)

bench.name: link_e2_mut_data
bench.note: OT_COLL_LINK2_MUT_DATA: retry bank 1 stores bit 140 of its slice inverted -> the link miter must fail

bench.name: q3_lpf_ars_eq
bench.note: SAFE q3 COLL parent ot_hfd_coll_q3_lpf_ars (2 x ot_hgi_coll_link_e1 = this leaf, body link_e2) == ot_hfd_coll_q3_hard_v8x (original 4-bank ot_hgi_coll_link_e) every output every cycle + 3 EQ mutants rejected
